rationale: v0.2 covers the load-bearing C5_CONTRACT comparisons {C3, C4, C5} only. Full all-vs-all C5_CONTRACT pairwise was deferred to save ~60% of pairwise call count. The omission affects breadth, not the core C5 mechanism test. These edges are backfillable in v0.3 or later without redesigning the experiment.

covered_in_v0_2.purpose: tests whether source packet + contract beats simpler explicit contract
tests whether source packet + contract beats or hurts the normal behavioral contract
tests whether adding a contract repairs source-packet fragility — the load-bearing comparison for C5_CONTRACT

deferred_edges.purpose: tests whether C5_CONTRACT beats no-profile baseline; expected yes given C5 already does, but worth confirming
tests whether C5_CONTRACT beats trait-labels condition
C1_padded is a length control for C1; pair is informative only after the basic C5_CONTRACT vs C1 result is known
C4_shuffled is a structure control for C4; pair is informative only after the basic C5_CONTRACT vs C4 result is known

backfill_command_template: uv run python -m psycheeval.judge pairwise --tag <v0.2-tag> --pilot v02_hard_pilot --pairs <PAIR_A>,<PAIR_B> --judges gpt-5.4,gpt-5.5,opus --workers 1
notes: These edges are NOT bugs in v0.2 coverage. They are intentional deferrals.
If v0.2 results raise a question that requires a deferred edge (e.g., 'does C5_CONTRACT also beat C0/C1?'), backfill that specific edge with the command template above.
Workers must be 1 for any Opus-side backfill (per the cap-burn hardening posture).
